Common.networkError: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and that the server is running.

Banners.lowDisk: The server is almost out of space ({size} left). Delete old downloads in History before downloading more.
Banners.noYtdlp: yt-dlp isn't installed or can't run on the server. Downloads will fail until it is (see YTDLP_PATH).
Banners.noFfmpeg: ffmpeg isn't installed on the server. Merging video and audio, converting audio and embedding won't work.

Download.subtitle: Paste a link from YouTube or <link>thousands of other sites</link>.

History.title: History
History.searchPlaceholder: Search by title, channel or link

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.subtitle: Server tools and yt-dlp updates.
Settings.languageHint: Detected from your browser on first visit. Saved in this browser.
Settings.ytdlpHint: Sites change often. If downloads start failing, updating yt-dlp usually fixes it.
Settings.nightlyHint: Latest fixes, best when a site just broke
Settings.storageUsed: {percent}% of the server's download disk is used. Delete old downloads in History to free space.
Settings.toolFfmpeg: Merges video and audio, converts audio, embeds thumbnails
Settings.toolDeno: Solves YouTube's JavaScript challenges; without it some formats are missing
Settings.customArgsHint: Accepted in the “Custom yt-dlp options” field of the download form.

ApiErrors.too_many_attempts: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {minutes} min.
ApiErrors.session_expired: Your session has expired, please log in again
ApiErrors.invalid_link: Please enter a valid link starting with http:// or https://
ApiErrors.args_too_long: Custom options are too long ({max} characters max)
ApiErrors.arg_unexpected: Unexpected “{arg}”: options must start with - (the link goes in the link field)
ApiErrors.arg_not_allowed: {arg} isn't allowed (see the list of allowed options)
ApiErrors.file_gone: The file is no longer on the server
ApiErrors.nothing_to_save: None of the selected downloads has a file to save
ApiErrors.invalid_channel: Channel must be stable or nightly
ApiErrors.update_busy: Wait for the running downloads to finish before updating yt-dlp
ApiErrors.update_failed: The update failed. See the output below.

JobErrors.invalid_url: That doesn't look like a valid URL.
JobErrors.unsupported_url: This website or link isn't supported by yt-dlp.
JobErrors.age_restricted: This video is age-restricted and needs a logged-in account.
JobErrors.bot_check: The site wants a sign-in to prove you're not a bot. Wait a bit and retry.
JobErrors.members_only: This video is for channel members only.
JobErrors.live_not_started: This live stream hasn't started yet.
JobErrors.unavailable: This video is unavailable (removed, private or region-locked).
JobErrors.http_429: The site is rate-limiting this server (HTTP 429). Wait a while and retry.
JobErrors.http_403: The site refused the download (HTTP 403). Updating yt-dlp usually fixes this.
JobErrors.format_unavailable: The selected quality or format isn't available for this video. Try “Best”.
JobErrors.ffmpeg_missing: ffmpeg is needed for this option (merging or converting) but isn't installed.
JobErrors.disk_full: The server ran out of disk space.
JobErrors.network: Couldn't reach the site. Check the link and the server's internet access.
JobErrors.interrupted: Interrupted by a server restart. Retry to download again.
JobErrors.ytdlp_missing: yt-dlp isn't installed on the server.
JobErrors.generic: The download failed. See details below.
